archetypes.name: dyn-guidelines-flow
archetypes.rationale: Cross-cutting guideline staging spans design, implement, ship, and final-report surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the architectural-guidelines lifecycle end to end. Focus on whether parsed guideline content stays untrusted, whether Phase A and Phase B ownership remains separated, and whether stale HEAD-pinned notes cannot leak into PR bodies or final summaries. Check the changed Python, skill, and reference-doc surfaces together. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-note-safety
archetypes.rationale: New repo-local prompt context and durable note files introduce injection and stale-artifact risks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new ARCHITECTURAL_GUIDELINES.md reader and implement note consumption for prompt-injection and path-safety issues. Pay special attention to symlink rejection, parsed-entry-only emission, redaction, and note_consumable HEAD matching. Confirm Python does not semantically assess guideline deviations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
